verses.text: Watch your steps when you go to God's house. It is better to come near and listen than to offer the sacrifice of fools, who do not even know they are doing wrong.
Do not speak too quickly, and do not let your heart rush to say anything before God. For God is in heaven, and you are on earth. So let your words be few.
Just as dreams come when you have too many worries, a fool's talk comes with too many words.
When you make a promise to God, do not wait to keep it, for he has no pleasure in fools. Keep what you promise.
It is better not to make a promise than to make one and not keep it.
Do not let your mouth lead you into sin. And do not tell the temple messenger, "It was a mistake." Why should God be angry at what you say and destroy the work of your hands?
For many dreams and many words are meaningless. Instead, have deep respect for God.

If you see the poor being treated cruelly in a district, and justice and fairness taken away by force, do not be surprised. For one official is watched by a higher official, and there are officials over them both.
The produce of the land is for everyone. Even the king gets his profit from the fields.
Whoever loves money will never have enough money, and whoever loves riches will never be satisfied with what they earn. This too is meaningless.
When good things increase, so do the people who use them up. And what does the owner gain, except to look at them with their eyes?
The sleep of a worker is sweet, whether they eat little or much. But the riches of the wealthy keep them from sleeping.
There is a terrible evil I have seen under the sun: riches that are stored up by their owner and end up hurting them.
Those riches are lost through bad luck, and when that person has a son, there is nothing left in their hand to give him.
Just as they came from their mother's womb, they will leave naked, as they came. They will take nothing from their hard work that they can carry in their hand.
This too is a terrible evil: exactly as they came, so they will go. What do they gain from working hard for the wind?
All their days they also eat in darkness. They are frustrated, sick, and angry.

Look, this is what I have seen to be good and right: for a person to eat and drink and enjoy the good in all their hard work under the sun, all the days of life God has given them. For this is their reward.
Also, when God gives a person riches and wealth, and the power to enjoy them, to accept their reward and be happy in their work, this is the gift of God.
Such a person will not often think about how short their life is, because God keeps them busy with the joy of their heart.
